Position Overview

Qui nous sommes
 Novelis est animé par la volonté de façonner ensemble un monde durable.
 En tant que leader mondial de produits et services innovants et le plus grand recycleur d'aluminium au monde d'aluminium, nous travaillons en partenariat avec des clients des secteurs de l'automobile, de l’aéronautique, des canettes et des spécialités pour fournir des solutions qui améliorent les avantages de l'aluminium léger.
 Nous disposons d'un réseau coordonné d'opérations de laminage et de recyclage techniquement sophistiquées sur 29 sites dans 9 pays d'Amérique du Nord, d'Amérique du Sud, d'Europe et d'Asie, avec 12.7 5 0 employés dans le monde. Le siège se situe à Atlanta, aux États-Unis.
 Nous comptons parmi nos clients certaines des marques les plus importantes et les plus connues au monde, notamment Coca-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, et d'autres. En outre, Novelis est à la pointe de l'industrie grâce à ses efforts en matière de durabilité et de recyclage.
 Participez à notre mission de créer un monde durable et commencez dès que possible à travailler sur notre site de Sierre , en Suisse
 Electricien/Automaticien(-ne) (100%)

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Vos responsabilités :

• Vous travaillez seul ou en équipe à l’amélioration ainsi qu’à la maintenance préventive et corrective de nos installations de production.

• Dans le cadre de projets, vous êtes responsable pour l’installation et la mise en service des équipements électriques.

• Le secteur d’activité s’étend de la distribution courant fort à la télématique, en passant par l’automation industrielle.

• La documentation des activités de maintenance dans SAP fait partie de vos tâches.

• Vous travaillez en service 4 équipes avec un service de piquet (3 semaines par an).

Comment nous convaincre :

• Titulaire d’un CFC d’automaticien ou d’installateur-électricien.

• Au moins 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle dans le domaine industriel.

• Expérience dans l’automation industrielle et les systèmes de supervision.

• Connaissance de SAP est un avantage.

• Intérêt pour le travail indépendant, responsable, efficace et en équipe.

• Grande flexibilité, motivation et esprit orienté client.

• Langue française ou allemande avec bonnes connaissances de la deuxième langue.

Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten :

• Sie arbeiten allein oder im Team an der Verbesserung sowie an der vorbeugenden und korrektiven Wartung unserer Produktionsanlagen.

• Im Rahmen von Projekten sind Sie für die Installation und Inbetriebnahme von elektrischen Anlagen verantwortlich.

• Der Tätigkeitsbereich erstreckt sich von der Starkstromverteilung über die industrielle Automatisierung bis hin zur Telematik.

• Die Dokumentation der Wartungsaktivitäten in SAP gehört zu Ihren Aufgaben.

• Sie arbeiten im 4-Schicht-Betrieb mit Pikettdienst (3 Wochen pro Jahr).

Wie Sie uns überzeugen :

• Inhaber/in eines EFZ als Automatiker/in oder Elektroinstallateur/in.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im industriellen Bereich.

• Erfahrung in der industriellen Automatisierung und in Überwachungssystemen.

• SAP-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Interesse an selbstständiger, verantwortungsbewusster, effizienter und teamorientierter Arbeit.

• Hohe Flexibilität, Motivation und kundenorientiertes Denken.

• Deutsche oder französische Sprache mit fundierten Kenntnissen in der zweiten Sprache.

Job Function/Category (Portal Searching)

Human Resources

Position Overview

Who we are
 Novelis is driven by its purpose of Shaping a Sustainable World Together.

As a global leader in innovative products and services and the world's largest recycler of aluminum, we partner with customers in the automotive, beverage can, aerospace and specialties industries to deliver solutions that improve the benefits of balanced lightweight aluminum.

We have a coordinated network of technically sophisticated rolling and recycling plants as well as foundries across 29 facilities in 9 countries throughout North America, South America, Europe, and Asia with 12,750 employees worldwide. The company is headquartered in Atlanta, USA.

Our customers include some of the largest and best-known brands in the world, including Coca-Cola, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, and others. In addition, Novelis is leading the industry with its sustainability and recycling efforts.

Become part of our mission to create a sustainable world and start as soon as possible at our location in Sierre as:

Responsibilities & Qualifications

What awaits you:

As Plant HR Manager, you are accountable for end-to-end HR at site level and translate the global people strategy into a robust site roadmap supporting business performance, operational excellence, workforce readiness, and full compliance.

Site HR Leadership & Business Partnering

• Define and deliver the Site HR Roadmap aligned with global strategy

• Act as trusted advisor to the Site Leadership Team

• Drive performance, leadership effectiveness, and organizational health

• Lead change, transformation, and cultural initiatives

• Manage HR budget and improve process efficiency

• Represent the site in global HR initiatives
 Employee Relations, Compliance & Governance

• Ensure labor law compliance and manage employee relations (investigations, grievances, disputes)

• Engage with employee representatives and social partners

• Represent HR in internal and external audits

• Ensure ethics, integrity, and a strong speak-up culture

• Enforce policies, controls, and regulatory requirements
 Talent, Leadership & Engagement

• Lead workforce planning aligned with current and future needs

• Oversee recruitment for critical roles

• Drive performance management, leadership development, and succession planning

• Ensure high-quality onboarding and employee development

• Execute learning & development initiatives

• Support internal communication and employer branding
 Payroll, Benefits & HR Operations

• Ensure accurate and compliant payroll and benefits governance

• Partner with Total Rewards on compensation practices

• Oversee time & attendance, absenteeism, and HR data quality

• Ensure proper HR administration and reporting governance
 Reporting & Analytics

• Deliver accurate and timely HR reporting

• Use HR KPIs to support data-driven decisions

• Monitor trends (retention, engagement, performance, workforce risks)
 How you convince us:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Law, Labor Relations, Psychology, HR Management, or related field

• You have 10+ years of HR leadership experience in a multinational environment

• You have proven site-level manufacturing HR leadership experience

• You have experience in matrix and/or multi-site organizations

• You are strong in strategic thinking and business acumen

• You have solid labor relations expertise

• You have the ability to influence, lead change, and drive transformation

• You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• You have a high integrity, cultural awareness, and interpersonal impact

• You are fluent in French and English; German is a plus
 What Novelis offers you:

#pensionplan: Your future matters to us! Enjoy a company pension scheme subsidized by Novelis, ensuring your financial security
 #health: We care about your well-being! Novelis contributions towards your dental expenses !
 #workplacebenefits: We prioritize your comfort and convenience with an attractive salary package, parkings, and an on-site company restaurant
 #development: Eager to enhance your knowledge and skills? Our individual training programs are designed to help you reach your full potential !
 #worklifebalance: Time for personal activities and relaxation is essential! Enjoy a 40-hour work week, days of holiday increasing according to age (with a minimum of 25 days), plus 9 official cantonal bank holidays and 5 additional paid holidays
 #goodies: Benefit from Novelis’ membership in Corporate Benefits with great purchaising deals from well-known brands in various areas
 Have we caught your interest?
 Then become part of our team! We are looking forward to your application!
 You can apply easily with your resume via our application system in less than 5 minutes.

Please note that postal applications cannot be processed and considered.

We live diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, and identity.

Location Profile

Novelis’ Sierre is located in the Valais Switzerland employing around 550 people. It mainly focuses on production of aluminium sheet for the automotive market covering the entire process from casting to finishing. The plant also hosts a world-leading Research & Innovation Center specialized in the development of new automotive sheet alloys surface treatment and joining technologies. In Feburary 2022 together with research institutions and a local energy provider Novelis founded the Net Zero Lab Valais to develop carbon-neutral solutions for aluminium manufacturing. The lab focuses on identifying and implementing innovative solutions to neutralize the carbon footprint of Novelis’ manufacturing operations and neighboring communities starting in Sierre.
 The Sierre plant supports its community through direct sponsorship of many annual events promoting education sports and culture.

Position Overview

Who we are
Novelis is driven by its purpose of Shaping a Sustainable World Together.

As a global leader in innovative products and services and the world's largest recycler of aluminum, we partner with customers in the automotive, beverage can, aerospace and specialties industries to deliver solutions that improve the benefits of balanced lightweight aluminum.

We have a coordinated network of technically sophisticated rolling and recycling plants as well as foundries across 29 facilities in 9 countries throughout North America, South America, Europe, and Asia with 12,750 employees worldwide. The company is headquartered in Atlanta, USA.

Our customers include some of the largest and best-known brands in the world, including Coca-Cola, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, and others. In addition, Novelis is leading the industry with its sustainability and recycling efforts.

Become part of our mission to create a sustainable world and start as soon as possible at our location in Sierre as:

Responsibilities & Qualifications

What awaits you:

As Plant HR Manager, you are accountable for end-to-end HR at site level and translate the global people strategy into a robust site roadmap supporting business performance, operational excellence, workforce readiness, and full compliance.

Site HR Leadership & Business Partnering

• Define and deliver the Site HR Roadmap aligned with global strategy

• Act as trusted advisor to the Site Leadership Team

• Drive performance, leadership effectiveness, and organizational health

• Lead change, transformation, and cultural initiatives

• Manage HR budget and improve process efficiency

• Represent the site in global HR initiatives
Employee Relations, Compliance & Governance

• Ensure labor law compliance and manage employee relations (investigations, grievances, disputes)

• Engage with employee representatives and social partners

• Represent HR in internal and external audits

• Ensure ethics, integrity, and a strong speak-up culture

• Enforce policies, controls, and regulatory requirements
Talent, Leadership & Engagement

• Lead workforce planning aligned with current and future needs

• Oversee recruitment for critical roles

• Drive performance management, leadership development, and succession planning

• Ensure high-quality onboarding and employee development

• Execute learning & development initiatives

• Support internal communication and employer branding
Payroll, Benefits & HR Operations

• Ensure accurate and compliant payroll and benefits governance

• Partner with Total Rewards on compensation practices

• Oversee time & attendance, absenteeism, and HR data quality

• Ensure proper HR administration and reporting governance
Reporting & Analytics

• Deliver accurate and timely HR reporting

• Use HR KPIs to support data-driven decisions

• Monitor trends (retention, engagement, performance, workforce risks)
How you convince us:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Law, Labor Relations, Psychology, HR Management, or related field

• You have 10+ years of HR leadership experience in a multinational environment

• You have proven site-level manufacturing HR leadership experience

• You have experience in matrix and/or multi-site organizations

• You are strong in strategic thinking and business acumen

• You have solid labor relations expertise

• You have the ability to influence, lead change, and drive transformation

• You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• You have a high integrity, cultural awareness, and interpersonal impact

• You are fluent in French and English; German is a plus
What Novelis offers you:

#pensionplan: Your future matters to us! Enjoy a company pension scheme subsidized by Novelis, ensuring your financial security
#health: We care about your well-being! Novelis contributions towards your dental expenses !
#workplacebenefits: We prioritize your comfort and convenience with an attractive salary package, parkings, and an on-site company restaurant
#development: Eager to enhance your knowledge and skills? Our individual training programs are designed to help you reach your full potential !
#worklifebalance: Time for personal activities and relaxation is essential! Enjoy a 40-hour work week, days of holiday increasing according to age (with a minimum of 25 days), plus 9 official cantonal bank holidays and 5 additional paid holidays
#goodies: Benefit from Novelis’ membership in Corporate Benefits with great purchaising deals from well-known brands in various areas
Have we caught your interest?
Then become part of our team! We are looking forward to your application!
You can apply easily with your resume via our application system in less than 5 minutes.

Please note that postal applications cannot be processed and considered.

We live diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, and identity.

Location Profile

Novelis’ Sierre is located in the Valais Switzerland employing around 550 people. It mainly focuses on production of aluminium sheet for the automotive market covering the entire process from casting to finishing. The plant also hosts a world-leading Research & Innovation Center specialized in the development of new automotive sheet alloys surface treatment and joining technologies. In Feburary 2022 together with research institutions and a local energy provider Novelis founded the Net Zero Lab Valais to develop carbon-neutral solutions for aluminium manufacturing. The lab focuses on identifying and implementing innovative solutions to neutralize the carbon footprint of Novelis’ manufacturing operations and neighboring communities starting in Sierre.
The Sierre plant supports its community through direct sponsorship of many annual events promoting education sports and culture.

Posizione Panoramica

Chi siamo
Novelis è guidato dal suo scopo di formare un mondo sostenibile insieme.
Come leader globale in prodotti e servizi innovativi e il più grande riciclatore di alluminio al mondo, collaboriamo con i clienti nel settore automotive, bevande, aerospaziale e specialità per fornire soluzioni che migliorino i vantaggi dell'alluminio leggero equilibrato.
Abbiamo una rete coordinata di impianti di laminazione e riciclaggio tecnicamente sofisticati e fonderie in 9 paesi in tutto il Nord America, Sud America, Europa e Asia con 13.250 dipendenti in tutto il mondo. La società ha sede ad Atlanta, USA.

I nostri clienti includono alcuni dei marchi più grandi e più noti al mondo, tra cui Coca-Cola, Ford, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung e altri. Inoltre, Novelis è leader del settore con i suoi sforzi di sostenibilità e riciclaggio.
Entrate nella nostra missione per creare un mondo sostenibile e iniziate nella nostra sede europea a Küsnacht (Zurich) Svizzera come:

Responsabilità e qualifiche

Cosa vi aspetta:

In qualità di Manager Finance – Digital Transformation & Business Projects, si svolgerà un ruolo di primo piano nella definizione del futuro della finanza attraverso la trasformazione digitale, l'automazione e le soluzioni avanzate AI-enabled. Lavorando attraverso FP&A, Controllership e Treasury, guiderai l'implementazione di tecnologie innovative, analisi, automazione e soluzioni AI che migliorano l'efficienza, migliorano il processo decisionale e creano valore aziendale. In stretta collaborazione con i partner commerciali di Supply Chain, Commercial, Operazioni e IT, aiuterete a modernizzare i processi finanziari, le funzionalità di reporting e analisi.

Ti riferirai direttamente al VP Finance e avrai l’opportunità di avere un impatto significativo sul viaggio di trasformazione digitale di Novelis Europe, costruendo una piattaforma forte per la crescita futura della carriera.

Trasformazione digitale, Automazione e AI

• Guidare l'identificazione, lo sviluppo e la distribuzione delle iniziative di digitalizzazione, automazione e AI attraverso i processi aziendali chiave Finance.

• Guidare l'adozione di tecnologie avanzate, tra cui soluzioni AI-powered (ad esempio, Microsoft Copilot), piattaforme di automazione, Power BI e strumenti di analisi dei dati.

• Serve come partner fondamentale per le iniziative di trasformazione digitale in Novelis Europe.

• Progettare e implementare soluzioni scalabili di reporting, pianificazione e analisi che forniscono informazioni tempestive sulle prestazioni finanziarie, produzione, spedizioni, inventario e KPI operativi.

• Sviluppa modelli di dati integrati e funzionalità di analisi che combinano dati finanziari e operativi per supportare il processo decisionale strategico e giornaliero.

• Guidare e sostenere iniziative di formazione che aumentano l'alfabetizzazione digitale e spingono l'adozione di nuove tecnologie attraverso la finanza e l'organizzazione più ampia.
Miglioramento continuo e business Partner

• Condurre l'esecuzione del progetto end-to-end dall'ideazione attraverso l'implementazione, assicurando la fornitura di benefici aziendali sostenibili.

• Rimanete aggiornati sulle tecnologie emergenti, sugli strumenti di automazione e sui progressi dell'IA per identificare le opportunità di innovazione continua all'interno della Finanza.

• Agire come Business Partner di Finanza, supervisionare analisi ad hoc che forniscono informazioni attuabili sulle prestazioni aziendali e sostenere le decisioni chiave.

• Costruire partnership forti tra Finanza, IT, Operazioni, Commerciale e Supply Chain per allineare le iniziative digitali con le priorità aziendali.
Come ci convinci:

• Laurea o Master in Sistemi Informativi, Data Analytics, Informatica, Business, Finanza o un campo relativo.

• Esperienza comprovata nella trasformazione digitale, nell'intelligenza aziendale, nell'analisi dei dati, nell'automazione dei processi o nei relativi ruoli focalizzati sulla tecnologia all'interno di un ambiente di produzione o industriale.

• Forte competenza in Power BI, modellazione dati e sistemi enterprise, supportati da diversi anni di esperienza SAP, preferibilmente all'interno di un ambiente di produzione. L'esperienza con OneStream, Databricks o piattaforme di pianificazione e analisi simili è un vantaggio.

• Il candidato preferito offre una forte competenza tecnica nella finanza operativa e produttiva, con esperienza nella pianificazione, previsione, costi, gestione delle prestazioni e rendicontazione finanziaria.

• Forte capacità di pensiero strategico, problem solving e comunicazione, con la capacità di collegare analisi dettagliate a obiettivi aziendali più ampi.

• Automotivato e pratico individuo con una comprovata capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e fornire risultati tangibili aziendali

• Fluente in inglese; tedesco è un vantaggio.

#pensionscheme: il tuo futuro ci conta! Godetevi un regime pensionistico aziendale sovvenzionato da Novelis, assicurando la vostra sicurezza finanziaria

Dovete essere autorizzati a lavorare in Svizzera senza sponsorizzazione del lavoro.

La sede regionale europea di Novelis si trova a Küsnacht appena fuori dalla Svizzera di Zurigo, impiegando circa 100 dipendenti provenienti da più di 20 paesi che ci permettono di abbracciare culture e comunità diverse e di spingere i confini attraverso un pensiero e un apprendimento unico.
L’ufficio centrale di Novelis ospita la strategia del team di Leadership Regionale e la gestione della sostenibilità della supply chain delle risorse umane delle comunicazioni aziendali legali e varie funzioni globali.
La sua posizione centrale in Europa lo rende un punto di partenza ideale per raggiungere altre città europee e impianti Novelis.

Lageübersicht

Wer wir sind
Novelis wird von seinem Ziel angetrieben, gemeinsam eine nachhaltige Welt zu gestalten.
Als weltweit führender Anbieter innovativer Produkte und Dienstleistungen und weltweit größter Wiederverwerter von Aluminium arbeiten wir mit Kunden aus der Automobil-, Getränkedosen-, Luft- und Raumfahrt- und Spezialindustrie zusammen, um Lösungen zu liefern, die die Vorteile von ausgewogenem leichtem Aluminium verbessern.
Wir verfügen über ein koordiniertes Netzwerk von technisch anspruchsvollen Walz- und Recyclinganlagen sowie Gießereien in 31 Werken in 9 Ländern in Nordamerika, Südamerika, Europa und Asien mit 13.250 Mitarbeitern weltweit. Das Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Atlanta, USA.

Zu unseren Kunden gehören einige der größten und bekanntesten Marken der Welt, darunter Coca-Cola, Ford, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung und andere. Darüber hinaus ist Novelis mit seinen Nachhaltigkeits- und Recyclingbemühungen führend in der Branche.
Werden Sie Teil unserer Mission, eine nachhaltige Welt zu schaffen und starten Sie in unserem europäischen Hauptsitz in Küsnacht, (Zürich) Schweiz als:

Verantwortlichkeiten und Qualifikationen

Was Sie erwartet:

Als Manager Finance – Digital Transformation & Business Projects spielen Sie eine führende Rolle bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft des Finanzwesens durch digitale Transformation, Automatisierung und fortschrittliche KI-fähige Lösungen. In den Bereichen FP&A, Controllership und Treasury werden Sie die Implementierung innovativer Technologien, Analysen, Automatisierung und KI-Lösungen vorantreiben, die die Effizienz steigern, die Entscheidungsfindung verbessern und Geschäftswert schaffen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftspartnern in den Bereichen Supply Chain, Commercial, Operations und IT unterstützen Sie die Modernisierung von Finanzprozessen, Reporting und Analysefunktionen.

Sie berichten direkt an den VP Finance und haben die Möglichkeit, einen wesentlichen Einfluss auf die digitale Transformation von Novelis Europe zu nehmen und gleichzeitig eine starke Plattform für zukünftiges Karrierewachstum aufzubauen.

Digitale Transformation, Automatisierung & AI

• Führen Sie die Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Digitalisierungs-, Automatisierungs- und KI-Initiativen für wichtige Geschäftsprozesse im Finanzbereich.

• Förderung der Einführung fortschrittlicher Technologien, einschließlich KI-gestützter Lösungen (z. B. Microsoft Copilot), Automatisierungsplattformen, Power BI und Datenanalysetools.

• Seien Sie der wichtigste Finanzpartner für digitale Transformationsinitiativen in Novelis Europe.

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie skalierbare Reporting-, Planungs- und Analyselösungen, die zeitnahe Einblicke in die finanzielle Performance, Produktion, Lieferungen, Inventar und operative KPIs bieten.

• Entwicklung integrierter Datenmodelle und Analysefunktionen, die Finanz- und Betriebsdaten kombinieren, um strategische und tägliche Entscheidungen zu unterstützen.

• Führen und unterstützen Sie Schulungsinitiativen, die die digitale Kompetenz verbessern und die Einführung neuer Technologien im Finanzwesen und in der gesamten Organisation vorantreiben.
Kontinuierliche Verbesserung & Business Partnering

• Führen Sie die End-to-End-Projektausführung von der Ideenfindung bis zur Umsetzung, um nachhaltige Geschäftsvorteile zu gewährleisten.

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über neue Technologien, Automatisierungstools und KI-Fortschritte, um Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliche Innovationen im Finanzbereich zu identifizieren.

• Handeln Sie als Finanzgeschäftspartner und überwachen Sie Ad-hoc-Analysen, die umsetzbare Einblicke in die Geschäftsleistung liefern und wichtige Entscheidungen unterstützen.

• Aufbau starker Partnerschaften in den Bereichen Finanzen, IT, Operations, Commercial und Supply Chain, um digitale Initiativen an den Geschäftsprioritäten auszurichten.
Wie Sie uns überzeugen:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informationssystemen, Data Analytics, Informatik, Business, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der digitalen Transformation, Business Intelligence, Datenanalyse, Prozessautomatisierung oder verwandten technologieorientierten Rollen in einer Fertigungs- oder Industrieumgebung.

• Starke Expertise in Power BI, Datenmodellierung und Unternehmenssystemen, unterstützt durch mehrjährige praktische SAP-Erfahrung, vorzugsweise in einer Fertigungsumgebung. Erfahrung mit OneStream, Databricks oder ähnlichen Planungs- und Analyseplattformen ist von Vorteil.

• Der bevorzugte Kandidat bringt eine starke technische Expertise in den Bereichen Betriebs- und Fertigungsfinanzierung mit Erfahrung in Planung, Prognose, Kostenrechnung, Leistungsmanagement und Finanzberichterstattung mit.

• Starkes strategisches Denken, Problemlösung und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, detaillierte Analysen mit breiteren Geschäftszielen zu verbinden.

• Selbstmotiviert und praxisorientiert mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und greifbare Geschäftsergebnisse zu liefern

• Fließend Englisch; Deutsch ist ein Vorteil.

Who we are

Novelis is driven by its purpose of Shaping a Sustainable World Together.

As a global leader in innovative products and services and the world's largest recycler of aluminum, we partner with customers in the automotive, beverage can, aerospace and specialties industries to deliver solutions that improve the benefits of balanced lightweight aluminum.

We have a coordinated network of technically sophisticated rolling and recycling plants as well as foundries across 29 facilities in 9 countries throughout North America, South America, Europe, and Asia with 12,750 employees worldwide. The company is headquartered in Atlanta, USA.

Our customers include some of the largest and best-known brands in the world, including Coca-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, and others. In addition, Novelis is leading the industry with its sustainability and recycling efforts.

Become part of our mission to create a sustainable world and start in our plants in Göttingen, Nachterstedt, Ohle, Koblenz or in our European Headquarter in Küsnacht , Switzerland as:

IT Solutions Lead (m/f/d)

What awaits you:
 Demand Execution & Solution Delivery

• Serve as the regional or capability-level point of contact for incoming business demand, capturing requests and performing initial triage before escalating to the Solutions Partner for prioritization decisions

• Manage demand intake, requirements gathering, solution design, estimation, and delivery execution using standardized processes and tools, ensuring alignment with business priorities, architecture standards, and cost objectives

• Oversee implementation through support transition, while monitoring solution performance, user experience, and service levels to ensure sustained business value and continuous improvement
 Local/Regional Application Stewardship

• Act as the business-side application steward for assigned small/regional applications, ensuring business continuity, stakeholder satisfaction, and alignment with global strategy

• Develop and maintain an application roadmap and identify and recommend application rationalization opportunities
 Strategy Support & Governance Contribution

• Contribute to technology roadmaps for assigned capability/functional areas by partnering with business capability leaders

• Monitor emerging technology trends and recommend innovations to the Solutions Partner to improve business outcomes and operational efficiency
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

• Foster strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and regional IT colleagues to ensure seamless service delivery and operational alignment

• Support change management and communication efforts to drive adoption of new solutions
 How you convince us:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field

• 7+ years of experience in IT business partnering, project management, or enterprise solutions delivery

• Knowledge of IT governance, demand management, and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL, Agile) and tools (e.g., Accolade, ServiceNow)

• Excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills

• Proficiency in German and English

• Proven ability to translate business needs into technology solutions, including requirements gathering, feasibility analysis, and business case development

• Demonstrated ability to deliver scalable, secure solutions that achieve business objectives and measurable outcomes

• Experience facilitating workshops and leading solution design sessions with business and technical stakeholders

• Proven ability to manage application health, performance, and user experience to deliver measurable business value

We live diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, and identity.

You must be authorized to work in Switzerland without employment sponsorship.

The position can be based at one of our German locations Koblenz, Göttingen, Ohle, or Nachterstedt, or at our Headquarters in Küsnacht, Switzerland.
